cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Make the Choice Rewrite the Past
cards.instruction: Make them choose between options whose consequences reinterpret an earlier promise, refusal, or agreement.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Put my spare key on the table or keep it. I'm settling what you meant last week by 'take some space.'

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I meant one quiet evening, not a new arrangement.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then keep it, and I'll treat that evening as over. You can come round as before.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: And if I give it back?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then I'll treat the quiet evening as the start of visiting by invitation. Put it here, and next time you ask before you come.
